# Efiook

"Being aware of the environmental degradation generated by energy production, we understand the importance of responsible consumption and energy efficiency. This is why, in principle, the project aims at reducing energy losses in Colombian households. Supported by the methodology of _x0093_Design thinking_x0094_ aims to develop the design of a more efficient pot, empathizing, defining, devising, prototyping and evaluating the design so that it finally takes advantage of the maximum energy that is supplied to it, reducing the cooking time of the food
